measurement_image.purpose: Hold DP pullup plus DM pulldown for DC measurements; no device protocol.

power_rails.interpretation: User reports all three DC supply checks are normal; no numeric voltages or ripple measurements supplied.

inference: The reported 0.42 ohm DP-DM resistance is a near-short and, together with both signal voltages around 2.6V and PHY LineState11 under FC45/IF00/OTG04, identifies a low-resistance connection between USB2 DP and DM as a direct electrical fault preventing valid USB signaling. The exact physical origin (connector-side solder/footprint/PCB versus PHY-side solder or internal failure) is not yet isolated. Missing digital VDD18 4.7uF remains a separate confirmed design deviation, not the proven cause of this low resistance.
next_requested_measurement: Pending physical isolation plan: inspect USB2 data pads, R7/R8 and U2 pins7/8; if no visible bridge, disconnect one end of R7 and measure each isolated R7 PCB pad to the common DM/R8 net to separate connector-side from PHY-side fault.
next_measurement_status: The 0.42 ohm result has been received. Short location has not yet been isolated; no rework or repair is claimed.
